decisions.reason: The role description and each negative claim are explicitly supported by the source.
The employer, dates, personal project work, training, handbook, and listed skills and achievements are supported. The corrected payroll start date is explicit.

The summary turns preferences into completed tool features: supervisors wanted understandable exceptions, and operators preferred a warning for late files, but the source does not say the tool implemented either. The claim that the tool was not sold externally is not established by a request to “是”（
The time reduction, six-run measurement, team attribution, personal contribution, coworker habit changes, and correction of the earlier figure and delivery-time confusion are supported.
The source explicitly supports training 12 coworkers in two workshops and writing the handbook; it also says exact workshop dates are unavailable.
The source explicitly supports personal use of Python to build Dispatch Loom and write its parser.
The source explicitly supports personal use of SQL to build Dispatch Loom and write its checks.
The source explicitly says PostgreSQL was used for the production database.
The source explicitly says Git was used for version control, and lists Git in the Collaboration skill category.
Personal coworker training is explicitly supported, as is its placement in the Collaboration skill category.
The degree, institution, and dates are stated explicitly.
The source explicitly identifies the certificate as fictional, gives its date, and clarifies that it was course completion rather than a professional license.
